what: Freeze cycle 6 (MASTHEAD M3, lander ruling 2026-11-27): the masthead's best judged ratio (best_tried) on the stored bright stress ground (masthead.BRIGHT_STRESS) per palette and lockup form, measured on Windows (the workstation) with STACK_SHIFT 0.5. DATA, not a verdict: the gate is 5.5:1 and the one-line readings sit within 0.13 of it, so a rasteriser difference of that size moves a verdict. The test holds each reading to TOLERANCE of its pin; the verdict rule itself is tested with probes far from the gate.
